name: Artist Statement Section
summary: Passive artist-authored statement with optional portrait, quotation, rich body, and editorial signature.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive thematic section associated with the contextual artist-name heading.

anatomy.name: portraitLayout
anatomy.description: Conditional layout modifier emitted only when portrait content exists.

anatomy.name: portraitImage
anatomy.description: Portrait image whose source, intrinsic data, crop, loading and alternative purpose are target-owned.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Ordered artist identity and statement content.

anatomy.name: name
anatomy.description: Contextual artist-name heading that names the section.

anatomy.name: quote
anatomy.description: Optional genuine quotation from the artist or another identified source.

anatomy.name: signature
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned editorial signature or artist mark without authenticity semantics.

anatomy.name: signatureImage
anatomy.description: Optional signature image whose alternative purpose remains target-owned.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Width follows the containing layout; canonical CSS responds to the component container.

states.name: without-portrait
states.description: Default one-column narrative with no portrait wrapper or portrait modifier.

states.name: with-portrait
states.description: Portrait precedes narrative and enables the wide sticky split when the component container permits it.

behavior.name: semanticGrouping
behavior.description: Complete adapters associate the native section with a target-unique contextual artist-name heading.

behavior.name: conditionalPortraitComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit absent portrait anatomy and add the portrait modifier only when portrait media is rendered.

behavior.name: narrativeOrder
behavior.description: Portrait remains before the statement in source order; responsive layout never changes reading order.

behavior.name: containerResponsive
behavior.description: The optional wide split responds to the component's inline size rather than the page viewport.

behavior.name: stickyPortrait
behavior.description: Sticky portrait positioning is visual-only and applies only in the wide portrait-present mode.

behavior.name: passiveCore
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no interaction, focus, controlled state, authenticity claim, network request or JavaScript runtime.

properties.name: portrait
properties.description: Target-owned portrait media with contextual alternative purpose and responsive image policy.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Artist display name rendered as the contextual section heading.

properties.name: quote
properties.description: Optional highlighted quotation rendered with native quotation semantics.

properties.name: body
properties.description: Target-owned artist statement rich content and inner semantics.

properties.name: signature
properties.description: Optional target-owned text or media mark; it does not attest identity or authenticity.

accessibility: Associate the native section with a target-unique artist-name heading id and choose heading rank from the surrounding document.
Use blockquote only when the highlighted content is a genuine quotation; keep attribution outside the quotation.
Determine portrait and signature image alternative text from purpose and context; decorative or redundant media uses empty alt.
Do not replace a visible textual signature with a redundant aria-label or claim signed/authenticated status without target evidence.
Preserve portrait-before-narrative source order at every width and in bidirectional content.
Keep the passive neutral section free of focus stops, widget roles, live regions and keyboard behavior.
Keep the quotation boundary perceivable in forced colors and ensure sticky presentation does not obscure zoomed or reflowed content.

web.notes: Native section composition and container-responsive presentation are implemented in components/css/storytelling.css.

shopify.notes: A localized merchant-configurable Liquid section maps portrait intent, editorial identity, quotation, rich body and optional text/image signature without neutral runtime or authenticity claims.
